name: Spanakopita-Inspired Flatbread with Creamy Feta, Spinach, Lemon & Dill
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Zest lemon into a medium bowl. Add ⅔ of the feta, yogurt, oil, pepper, and salt. Mash with a fork until semi-smooth and combined, then set aside. (Reserve lemon and remaining feta for later use.)

Arrange flatbreads on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until flatbreads are slightly crispy, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
Meanwhile, juice reserved lemon into a small bowl.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with oil and salt, then stir to combine.

Once the skillet is hot, add lemon-oil mixture. Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Cook, stirring frequently, until wilted, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Spread the creamy feta over each flatbread, then top with sautéed greens and reserved feta.
To serve, cut flatbreads into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
